data.one_liner: Stores shared preferences as encrypted values on device storage.
data.what_it_does: This plugin stores values as encrypted data using shared preferences and decrypts them automatically when retrieved. It supports custom encryption modes and passing custom shared preferences instances.
use_when: You need to store simple key-value pairs securely using encryption.
You want a drop-in encrypted alternative to standard shared preferences.
avoid_when: You require complex relational querying or large dataset storage.
Platform-native secure keystore/keychain bindings are strictly required instead of encrypted shared preferences.
strengths: Easy to use with an API similar to standard shared preferences.
Supports multiple AES encryption modes of operation.
Allows access to the internal shared preferences instance.
weaknesses: Relying on shared preferences encryption might not meet strict hardware-backed secure storage requirements compared to dedicated keychain/keystore plugins.

alternatives.name: flutter_secure_storage
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides secure storage using keychain and encrypted keystore natively on supported platforms.

alternatives.name: shared_preferences
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you do not need encryption and prefer standard unencrypted key-value storage.
